judged_text: TopicEmbed.import silently returns nil when post creation fails (post.blank? leaves no TopicEmbed and returns nil), and poll_feed discards the return value with no log and no error result. A feed item whose topic/post creation fails is dropped without a trace while the poll job completes 'successfully' — operators have no way to discover that imported articles are missing.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] TopicEmbed.import silently returns nil when post creation fails (post.blank? leaves no TopicEmbed and returns nil), and poll_feed discards the return value with no log and no error result. A feed item whose topic/post creation fails is dropped without a trace while the poll job completes 'successfully' — operators have no way to discover that imported articles are missing.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when `PostCreator#create` returns nil/blank, the code simply skips `TopicEmbed.create!` and falls through to `post` being nil (`post = creator.create` then `if post.present? ... end`; method returns `post` at end). In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, each feed item calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)` and ignores the return value, with no logging or error handling. This is a diff-grounded robustness/observability concern (silent drop on failure), but the diff does not prove that such failures will actually occur in normal operation, so it's not a verifiable defect on its own.
